verdict.rationale: Docs describe a review queue for flagged payments (docs-11, docs-18) that surfaces risk insights/signals (docs-19) and a network of related payments by customer ID, IP, or card (docs-12), plus approve/reject actions via API (docs-8, docs-21) enabling quick, consistent decisions. Missing for 10: explicit dedicated 'customer history' panel documentation and independent/hands-on confirmation that the queue UI delivers this context smoothly (community feedback notes UI clarity issues around overriding blocks, comm-3).
